assessment: Admission checks actual device adapter-specific features, 8x support and matching UNORM alias usage plus multisampled shading/view formats. Restore pipeline validation refusal prevents optional prefix strategy. Native Main initialization/recovery explicitly admit; unsupported/capture consumers use shared full fallback.

A gains sampled usage and matching UNORM alias; required B has UNORM render alias. Views share tracked allocations. Restore shader textureLoad addresses integer framebuffer pixel and actual sample_index, with no blend, full write mask, no alpha-to-coverage. Scissors repeat only idempotent restore draw.

Shared predicate is generated once and binds screen/glyph at group1 and terminal at group2. Console/menu rebinding is explicit. Glyph color early return still follows predicate; terminal textureSample precedes conditional discard, preserving derivative control flow. Prefix/dialog paths explicitly use unrestricted uniform.

Admitted B now stores final samples; full cold reconstruction remains unrestricted. Restricted mask refusal selects full reconstruction. Session matching-completion metadata governs reuse; later exact8x proof must cover failed submitted attempts and dropped/superseded receipts.

Restricted buffer is immutable mapped-at-creation, not queue.write_buffer; tracked528-byte allocation reserves screen/process/generation budgets before construction. Two queued generations share budget across replacement. Queue completion holds restricted buffer and unrestricted buffer plus exact encoded A/B aliases. No mutable in-flight uniform write found.
Mask binding/layout compatibility is structural across independently created explicit layouts with identical entries. Common painter order preserved.
Observed no new source dependency, cap increase, global tuning or per-rectangle world/suffix replay. New allocation/metadata churn and backend performance are unmeasured.

Timing still excludes final upload and multi-submission work until later approved correction; current source must not be used to qualify complete frame time. Existing query test names/old negative controls need r3 conformance updates before credit.
Native resource stream/refusal expectations and exact all-sample/oracle controls are parent verification work; reviewer has executed none.

Wrong sample-zero shader and incompatible sRGB destination validation controls present. Scratch resources are explicitly excluded from candidate resource-budget evidence.
Independent oracle save/swap isolates B and preserves candidate prefix state. Oracle shares current source/preparation/painter, so agreement alone cannot independently validate preparation semantics.

Existing aggregate remains ignored. Omitted-old-damage, omitted-suffix-mask, stale-B negatives and multi-submission/final-upload timing proof still pending per parent; old r2 negatives do not silently satisfy new r3 faults.

Sample helper currently waits indefinitely for GPU readback; prefer a bounded poll/receive or an explicit enclosing proof timeout when executing the one bounded batch. This does not affect production rendering.
